title: fix: standardize community model UI
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses the Community logo for every community model, independent of optional brand metadata.
- Places brand links consistently below model slugs on desktop and mobile.
- Renames Provider Profile to Brand and disables Save until its values change.
- Uses `@pollinations/ui` tabs and dropdowns throughout Add Model, including a checkmark for the selected modality.
- Applies the standard danger treatment to Cancel.
- Keeps branding presentation-only; routing, pricing, and ownership are unchanged.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write ...`
- `npx vitest run test/pricing-data.test.ts` — 35 passed
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- Verified on `https://staging.enter.pollinations.ai/models`

gist.headline: One badge to bind them
gist.blurb: Community models now wear the same little community badge, even when their brand metadata has other ideas. The model garden is tidier, and the buttons have learned manners.
gist.summary: Standardized the community-model interface so every community model uses the Community logo, brand links sit below model slugs on desktop and mobile, and the Add Model flow uses shared @pollinations/ui tabs and modality dropdowns.
gist.impact: People browsing or adding community models get a more consistent model table and editor, with clearer Brand settings, selected-modality checkmarks, a disabled-until-changed Save button, and standard danger styling for Cancel.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is tending a neatly organized garden of community-model seed packets, each marked with the same Community flower badge while small brand-name plaques sit consistently beneath them. A friendly CRT monitor robot helps sort modality tabs and dropdown labels, representing the cleaned-up Add Model interface.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workbench where Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black antennae, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small smile, light-blue rounded wings, and a tiny gardener apron, carefully arranges community-model seed packets with matching Community flower badges and brand plaques beneath each label; a chunky CRT monitor robot holds a dropdown with a checkmark. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, code-plants and flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm.
